tagline: Digital workflows to transform the way people work
hero_kpi_rationale: Cloud backlog (RPO) is the primary leading indicator of future revenue at ServiceNow, reflecting enterprise confidence in its automation platform and its ability to capitalize on the AI wave through multi-year contracts.

kpis.name: Cloud Backlog (cRPO)
kpis.explanation: Amount of future contractual revenue not yet recognized, to be recognized over the next 12 months.
kpis.description: cRPO (Current Remaining Performance Obligations) reaches 46% of total RPO, or $12.972 billion, up 25% year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Strong short-term backlog growth, indicating sustained demand.

kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligations
kpis.explanation: Total future contractual revenue not yet recognized, including unbilled but non-cancellable amounts.
kpis.description: Total RPO includes deferred revenue and future non-cancellable amounts, reflecting medium-term revenue visibility.
kpis.signal: RPO at $28.2B, 27% growth: strong signal of sales traction.

kpis.name: Customers >$5M in annual value
kpis.explanation: Number of customers generating more than $5 million in annual revenue.
kpis.description: The number of high-ACV customers increases from 502 in 2024 to 603 in 2025, up 20%, showing strong adoption among large enterprises.
kpis.signal: 603 customers >$5M: evidence of penetration into enterprise accounts.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of services, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high, consistent with the SaaS model's low variable cost structure.
kpis.signal: High gross margin typical of cloud software vendors.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves due to efficiency gains and scale.

kpis.name: R&D (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses divided by revenue.
kpis.description: ServiceNow maintains a high R&D rate, consistent with its continuous innovation strategy on the AI platform.
kpis.signal: High investment in innovation, particularly in AI.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures increase to support platform infrastructure and AI integration.
kpis.signal: Capex rising to strengthen cloud infrastructure.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount reaches 18,500 employees, up 8%, primarily in sales and engineering.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth to support business expansion.

risks.title: Data regulations hinder optimization capabilities
risks.score_rationale: Positioned as top-tier risk with explicit mention of restrictions on data usage, storage, and transfer, referencing constraining regulations including EU Data Regulation and Transatlantic framework. Strong language on operational and geographic impact. Regulation category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Failure to innovate against technology competition
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language on innovation velocity, native AI, automation, and intensified competition. Existential risk underscored by threat of market share erosion, margin compression, and customer acceptance loss. Central position in document.

risks.title: AI integration creates legal and ethical risks
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mentions of operational, regulatory, and ethical challenges tied to AI, with explicit reference to European AI Act. Growing and strategically highlighted risk. Technology category significantly impacted.

risks.title: Cybersecurity: perceived or actual breaches
risks.score_rationale: Presented as material risk driving customer losses, litigation, and reputational damage. Strong language on security perception concerns. Elevated position in operational risk section.

risks.title: Rising revenue dependency on partners
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of increased revenue reliance on partners. Direct operational risk if partners underperform. Secondary position but reinforced by complex sales cycle context.

risks.title: International expansion obstacles
risks.score_rationale: 37% of revenue derived outside North America, yet repeated regulatory, cultural, and operational barriers cited. Heavy investment with no guaranteed returns. Strategic risk to growth trajectory.

risks.title: Key talent loss or recruitment challenges
risks.score_rationale: Direct mention in operational risks with linkage to innovation and growth capacity. Concerned language on talent retention. Critical key person category in tech environment.

ai_positioning.summary: ServiceNow is actively integrating AI into its platform to automate enterprise workflows, positioning itself as an orchestrator between AI models and operational systems. It does not develop AI models, but leverages them to generate concrete actions.
evidence: The ServiceNow AI Platform enables secure and governed operationalization of AI strategies.
The company emphasizes that AI alone cannot execute transactions or update systems: its role is to orchestrate action.
Acquisition of Armis Security in 2026 to enhance AI security capabilities in IT environments.
